deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 19 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Partition Width\""

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; returns a width value without its range/array identity, non-zero validation or topology meaning.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds non-zero and Type 16/17 topology checks but lowers capability for pending inputs.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; retained agent-direct collection after operator target selection and sanity review.

original_test_intent: Validate non-zero Type 19 Partition Width for each mapped range as the number of memory devices forming that range, consistently related to its Type 16 array and Type 17 device topology before and after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 16/17/19/20 records, bind each width to its Type 19 range/array, validate the non-zero value and approved topology meaning without equating it blindly to installed DIMM count, then repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user defines expected partition topology and approves reboot; no DIMM manipulation or memory remapping is intrinsic.
required_inputs: Expected Partition Width per range and its precise topology meaning
safety_requirements: Use read-only collection; do not change DIMMs, channels, firmware, kernel or memory map.
Require non-zero width and bind it to the exact Type 19 range and Type 16 array.
Do not assume Partition Width equals populated DIMM count without approved topology semantics.
Require reboot approval/recovery; stop on topology contradiction or boot failure and do not auto-retry.
agent_execution_scope: Parse every range/handle/width, enforce non-zero, compare with approved Type 16/17/20 topology and produce pre/post reboot diffs.
Report zero, invalid, contradictory or drifting widths without deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve width meaning/count and special topology cases plus reboot plan.
Resolve firmware topology versus physical inventory differences and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is correct, but grep -A1 cannot identify the owning range/array, enforce non-zero or interpret the count against topology.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive full Type 16/17/19/20 raw/decoded data; report each range, array handle, raw width, non-zero result, approved topology comparison and pre/post diff.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Partition Width scope, Type 19 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; no topology change is added.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind each non-zero Partition Width to its Type 19 range and resolved Type 16 array, compare against approved Type 17/20 topology semantics, and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS systems exposing Type 19 partition width.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, firmware and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 19 Partition Width and Type 16/17/20 relationship definitions plus platform topology.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds non-zero enforcement, exact range ownership and topology-aware meaning.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects zero, detached or topology-inconsistent values missed by isolated text grep.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Partition Width is not necessarily the installed DIMM count; logical/interleaved mappings require platform interpretation.

project_override_considerations: Project topology may define distinct widths for ranges or soldered/logical memory, but must state them per range; it cannot waive the non-zero and ownership checks.
expected_evidence: Approved width meaning/count and topology policy
Complete pre-reboot raw Type 16/17/19/20 records and versions
Per-range array handle, raw width, non-zero result and Type 17/20 topology comparison
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot topology diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Partition Width is a defined Type 19 field; expected topology is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Non-zero, relationship and topology comparisons are software-automatable after inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds range ownership, non-zero and topology-semantic validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains topology safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates topology/reboot readiness and engineer verdict from capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a width string from passing when zero, attached to the wrong range or naively equated to DIMM count.
independent_technical_reasoning: Width is a structural count interpreted in its range topology; parsing and comparison are deterministic read-only work.
